Who We Help  /  Startups

Build on something you can grow out of.

Where we usually come in

Accounts and ownership

Domains, email, and shared logins registered to the company — not to whoever set them up on a Tuesday.

Security that fits stage

Two-factor, device basics, and access control at a level that won't slow a team of four down.

Tooling choices

An honest read on what to buy, what to skip, and what you'll regret at twenty people.

AI, used carefully

Where a model genuinely helps, where it leaks your data, and how to write a short internal policy.

How we'd start

Usually a couple of sessions, then we stay reachable.

  1. 01 A working session. Ninety minutes on what you have, what you plan, and where the sharp edges are.
  2. 02 A short written plan. Prioritized, costed roughly, and readable by a non-technical cofounder or board member.
  3. 03 We do the setup with you. Not for you — with you, so your team knows how it works once we're gone.

Need someone on call without a full-time hire?

Short-term and long-term engagements are both on the table. Rates are sliding-scale and quoted before any work starts.
